sentence: Hey, welcome back. I think a memorable character needs a little courage, a little chaos, and someone who sees them clearly.
heldOut: The little fox waited by the window while the rain tapped softly on the glass.
A good story gives every choice a consequence, even when nobody else is watching.
Would you trust a hero who always knows exactly what to say?
Please bring a blue notebook and three clean glasses to the kitchen table.
You do not have to be perfect to make something worth sharing.
Some characters hide their fear behind a joke. Others find the courage to ask for help.
note: ASR intelligibility thresholds measure recognition, not subjective voice quality or similarity to any character. Evaluation uses a separate pretrained recognizer, not a speech-generation model.
